Verblib 0.5, Philip Bennefall. Freeverb-derived stereo reverb, public domain / Unlicense (full terms at end of verblib.h).
Source: https://github.com/blastbay/verblib
Vendored without modifications. The application uses this C reverb, not Apple Audio Units.
Delay is Tonora's own stereo feedback delay; not part of Verblib.
